name: server
description: CyberGuard AI API — Express + MongoDB, running the same detection engines as the app
//test: Bare `node --test` auto-discovers test files and works from Node 18. Passing a quoted glob instead needs Node 21+, which silently broke CI on the Node 20 the engines field allows.
//dev: --watch-path is not optional. Unscoped, the watcher restarted the API in a loop whenever anything moved in the Flutter tree, because MODELS_DIR (src/config/env.js) deliberately points outside web/ at the repo's assets/models. Each restart costs a model parse plus a Mongo connect, so the API was refusing connections for most of any working session.
